items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: You get all the Richard Rodgers songs and you see hey he wrote this, he wrote that, then you build a repertoire.

ctx.x: Okay. But somebody needs to know, right? Hopefully the bass player, right?

Yeah I have to know the songs — I learn the songs according to the composers. You get all the Richard Rodgers songs and you see hey he wrote this, he wrote that, then you build a repertoire. That’s the way I learned it.
Do you have an opinion why most of the songs like from the Great American Songbook are in flat keys?
